label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Here's a review that gives the full picture without hanging Dessie out to dry:

---

Used these lads for a move on Saturday 17 October, Phibsborough to Drumcondra. Two-bed flat but mostly my own stuff, and the new place is a fourth floor walk-up with no lift, which I should have made clearer when booking.

Quote was €340 for up to four hours, two lads and the van. Booked through their website and paid the €50 deposit by Revolut, no hassle at all. Job took about three and a half hours, so the quote held.

The one thing I'd want to know if I was reading this before booking: they were late. Booked for 9, arrived at half 10. I got a text at 8:40 saying the previous job had overrun, which I appreciated, better than being left guessing, but I was sitting on a pile of boxes with a cold coffee for an hour and a half. If you've a tight handover with a landlord or you're paying for a lift slot, build in a bit of slack or ring them the day before to confirm. For me it wasn't the end of the world, I had the day free.

Fair play to Dessie though, he knocked €40 off the price after, off his own bat, I never asked him for it. That's the kind of thing that makes you go back to a crowd.

The lads themselves worked hard. The couch wasn't going round the turn on the third floor, and one of the young fella, Kev I think, had the legs off it with an allen key out of his pocket before anyone started panicking. Straight in after that. They put the bed back together without being asked and took away a flat-pack shelf I didn't want, which saved me a run to the dump.

My one gripe, and it's small but it matters to me: the base of my brass floor lamp got chipped. Everything else was wrapped in blankets and looked after properly, but the lamp wasn't, and it was my nanny's so I was a bit gutted when I saw it. Not a disaster and I'm not looking for anything off them for it. Just wrap the lamps lads. It's a two-minute job with a blanket and it saves someone a bad evening.

Would I use them again? Yeah, honestly. Best value I found, the other quotes I got were €450 and up for the same job. They're sound, they work fast, and the price didn't move.

Four stars rather than five because of the lateness and the lamp, which I think is fair.

If you're moving: confirm the start time the day before, tell them about stairs and lifts upfront, and wrap anything you'd be upset about yourself before they arrive.
